case_name: Lopez / Hendrickson / Bell / Ortiz / Castillo v. GEO Secure Services
court: Cal. Super. Ct. Imperial plus related state/federal courts
status: Executed settlement; preliminary approval entered Jan. 22, 2024; later federal order describes Lopez as finally settled
class_or_collective_scope: Settlement-only class of all non-exempt GEO Secure Services employees in California, Apr. 11, 2020-Sep. 30, 2023
practice_or_theory: Five complaints collectively alleged overtime, minimum wage, meal/rest, wage-statement, expense, vacation, UCL, and PAGA claims
result: Executed non-reversionary settlement resolving five actions; certification only for settlement; no admission
public_monetary_record: $3,690,000 gross; up to $1,230,000 fees; up to $50,000 costs; $150,000 PAGA allocation; up to $10,000 for each of five representatives
merits_limit: Settlement is not an adjudication that any alleged practice occurred; defendant denied liability
recap_final_record_gap: State-court final approval order was not retrieved in this wave; executed agreement and entered preliminary order are public outside RECAP
ranking_basis: Largest primary-documented employee wage resolution; five related actions and statewide class

status: Three collectives conditionally certified; later settlement approved and case dismissed with prejudice
class_or_collective_scope: Correctional-facility instructors, lieutenants, and case managers; notice limited to employees from Nov. 9, 2006
practice_or_theory: Misclassification for salaried instructors/lieutenants; alleged Kronos pre-shift and post-shift nonpayment for hourly case managers
result: Initial-stage conditional certification Nov. 9, 2009; scope clarified Jan. 15, 2010; settlement approved June 14, 2011
public_monetary_record: Settlement amount and fees unavailable in public RECAP copy
merits_limit: Conditional certification used a lenient notice-stage standard and did not decide liability
recap_final_record_gap: Settlement agreement, fee motion, and final approval order are indexed but not downloadable in RECAP
ranking_basis: Strongest published procedural ruling tying corporate job descriptions and timekeeping allegations to multiple employee groups

case_name: Mayes v. The GEO Group, Inc.
status: 1,446 consent filers accepted as party plaintiffs; settlement approved; dismissed with prejudice
class_or_collective_scope: Complaint alleged correctional officers at 49 facilities in 17 states
practice_or_theory: Alleged timekeeping rounding denied pre-shift and post-shift compensation
result: Court accepted 1,446 opt-ins Aug. 18, 2009; approved collective settlement and dismissed with prejudice Oct. 30, 2009
public_monetary_record: Settlement amount unavailable in public RECAP copy
merits_limit: Facility count and rounding practice are complaint allegations; approval did not adjudicate liability
recap_final_record_gap: Settlement agreement and approval order are indexed but not downloadable in RECAP
ranking_basis: Largest visible employee-participant count and alleged nationwide facility scope

case_name: Perez v. The GEO Group, Inc.
court: S.D. Cal.; Cal. Super. Ct. San Diego
status: Federal case dismissed without prejudice; related state class/collective settlement received final approval Oct. 6, 2023
class_or_collective_scope: Complaint proposed nationwide FLSA collective and California class of non-exempt hourly employees receiving cash in lieu of benefits
practice_or_theory: Alleged exclusion of cash-in-lieu benefit payments from regular-rate calculations for overtime and California premiums
result: Federal dismissal without prejudice Dec. 13, 2022; Mazzei ECF 27 judicially noticed state final approval
merits_limit: Complaint allegations were not adjudicated in federal court; state settlement is not a liability finding
recap_final_record_gap: State settlement agreement and final approval order not recovered from RECAP
ranking_basis: Distinct regular-rate theory with nationwide pleading and confirmed state class/collective settlement

case_name: Giles v. Community Education Centers, Inc.
status: Final class settlement approval and judgment Dec. 19, 2017
class_or_collective_scope: Settlement class; exact class definition unavailable in RECAP documents reviewed
practice_or_theory: California wage-and-hour claims against CEC, acquired by GEO in April 2017
public_monetary_record: $285,000 fees; $5,584.32 costs; $10,000 and $7,500 representative awards; gross fund not established from primary document
merits_limit: The action predated GEO's acquisition of CEC and settlement does not establish GEO-originated practices
recap_final_record_gap: Settlement, final approval order, and judgment are described in the docket but not downloadable in RECAP
ranking_basis: Substantial class resolution, but legacy-company timing and incomplete settlement record reduce direct GEO weight

case_name: Garcia v. The GEO Group, Inc.
status: Individual FLSA settlement approved; dismissed with prejudice before class/collective certification
class_or_collective_scope: Complaint proposed nationwide collective and Pennsylvania class; none was certified
result: Court approved individual settlement as fair and reasonable resolution of bona fide FLSA dispute
public_monetary_record: $17,000 total: $4,191.11 wages; $4,191.11 alleged liquidated damages; $8,617.78 fees/costs
merits_limit: No class result and no admission; GEO continued to deny liability
recap_final_record_gap: Key complaint, agreement, and approval order are available in RECAP
ranking_basis: Balanced counterexample: systemic pleading narrowed to one employee's settlement

case_name: Pasillas v. The GEO Group, Inc.
status: Claims sent to arbitration; federal docket remained open for status reports through Aug. 29, 2025
class_or_collective_scope: Putative California classes of non-exempt employees; plaintiff alleged work at El Centro
practice_or_theory: Alleged off-clock security checks, radios during meal/rest periods, walking time, and health-and-wellness regular-rate omissions
result: No public merits or class-certification ruling; arbitration posture
merits_limit: All practices remain allegations; arbitration materially limits public merits visibility
recap_final_record_gap: Complaint is available; arbitration record and merits outcome are not public in RECAP
ranking_basis: Current recurrence signal, but unresolved and allegation-only

case_name: Mazzei v. GEO Secure Services, LLC
status: Individual claims settled/dismissed with prejudice; uncertified putative-class claims dismissed without prejudice
class_or_collective_scope: Proposed California employee class; no certification sought or obtained
practice_or_theory: Alleged California wage, meal/rest, expense, safety, and unfair-competition claims
result: Case closed Dec. 3, 2024 after individual settlement; court expressly said no class was certified
merits_limit: No class recovery and no merits adjudication; class claims unaffected and dismissed without prejudice
recap_final_record_gap: Individual settlement agreement not public in RECAP
ranking_basis: Useful map of six related California cases, but weak standalone systemic outcome

case_name: Burch v. The GEO Group, Inc.
status: Notice of settlement followed by stipulated dismissal without prejudice
class_or_collective_scope: Putative class alleged; no public certification ruling
practice_or_theory: California employment allegations; specific settlement terms unavailable
merits_limit: Notice of settlement and dismissal do not establish class relief or liability
recap_final_record_gap: Settlement terms and complaint merits record incomplete in RECAP
